about: The Gospel of the feast of the Most Holy Trinity, Matthew 28:18–20. The risen Christ sends the disciples to teach and baptize in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Ghost.

seg.tr: At that time Jesus said to His disciples: All power is given to Me in heaven and on earth.
Going therefore, teach ye all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost; teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you.
And behold, I am with you all days, even to the consummation of the world.
